# Infynix Solutions (India)

> Infynix Solutions is a Growth Engineering company: three divisions that build the marketing, media and business systems a company needs to attract, convert and scale. This file describes the India site at https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com.

## Business
- Legal name: Infynix Solutions
- Office: 3rd Floor, Oberon Mall, Padivattom, Edappally, Kochi, Kerala, 682024, IN
- Telephone: +91-99959-11173
- Email: office@infynixsolutions.ae
- Areas served: United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, India, Kerala, Kochi, Ernakulam, Kozhikode, Calicut, Thrissur, Thiruvananthapuram
- Contact page: https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/contact

## Divisions
### Infynix Agency (Performance and digital marketing)
Paid media, search, social and the measurement underneath them. The side of the business that creates demand and proves where it came from.
- Hub: https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/infynix-agency
- [Performance Advertising](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/performance-advertising): Data-driven paid media campaigns on Google, Meta, and LinkedIn designed for direct sales return.
- [SEO & Content Marketing](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/seo-content-marketing): Technical search pre-rendering, clean HTML tags, and commercial keyword rankings.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/social-media-management): Building active social profiles and brand authority on social channels.
- [Marketing Automation & CRM](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/marketing-automation-crm): Automating lead follow-ups, email drips, and CRM synchronization.
- [Performance Marketing & Paid Ads](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/performance-marketing): We manage targeted ad campaigns on Google, Meta, and LinkedIn focused on customer acquisition and return on ad spend.
- [SEO Services & Search Infrastructure](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/seo-services): We engineer technical search pre-rendering, clean HTML tags, and keyword content to help your business rank at the top of search engine results.
- [UI/UX Design & Brand Styling](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/ui-ux-design): We design digital product layouts and visual brand styles that look modern and guide users to buy.

### Infynix Growth Solutions (Software, ERP and business systems)
Custom web applications, CRM and ERP development, business automation, cloud infrastructure and AI vision systems. The engineering practice.
- Hub: https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/infynix-growth-solutions
- [AI Surveillance & Security Solutions](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/ai-surveillance): Real-time AI computer vision security, local edge processing, and automated threat alerts for commercial facilities.
- [Custom Web & App Development](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/custom-web-app-development): Custom web software engineered in React 19 and Next.js built for your business operations.
- [AI Product Development & Agents](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/ai-native-product-development): Building smart software tools powered by Large Language Models and AI agents.
- [Website Development Services](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/website-development): We build fast, secure web platforms using React 19 and Next.js designed to convert visitors into clients.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/mobile-app-development): We develop custom mobile applications for iOS and Android built for speed, offline usability, and clear navigation.
- [Artificial Intelligence & AI Integration](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/artificial-intelligence): We build custom AI agents and workflow tools that automate daily administrative tasks.
- [Business Automation Solutions](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/business-automation): We connect your software tools with automated APIs so your team spends zero time copying data by hand.
- [Custom CRM & ERP Software](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/crm-erp-development): We build custom CRM and business management software designed around how your company actually operates.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & Hosting](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/cloud-solutions): We set up and manage secure cloud hosting on AWS, Google Cloud, and Vercel.

### Infynix Media (Content, film and production)
Brand films, photography, motion graphics and short-form social content, produced in house.
- Hub: https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/infynix-media
- [Photography & Videography](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/photography-videography): Product, brand and corporate photography and video, shot on location across Kerala by our own team in Kochi.
- [Brand Films & Commercials](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/brand-films-commercials): Brand films, ad films and corporate video, written and produced end to end for Kerala and national campaigns.
- [Short-Form & Social Content](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/short-form-social-content): Reels, shorts and vertical video produced in volume, cut for the platform and the language each audience actually watches in.
- [Motion Graphics & Animation](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/motion-graphics-animation): Explainer animation, product motion and title design for brands whose product is difficult to film.
- [Podcast & Audio Production](https://www.infynixgrowthsolutions.com/solutions/podcast-audio-production): Recording, editing and distribution for brand podcasts and audio series, in Malayalam and English.
